Additionally, the candidate completely omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update specified in the acceptance criteria. While `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` was edited, the new guarantee was left inside the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section right under the paragraph stating 'This issue changes none of them', rather than moving it to the active spec section as the reference did. Finally, the candidate created a standalone test file and left behind a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
